info.title: Briesa Compliance API
info.summary: Australian compliance decision support, delivered as industry packs.
info.description: Decision support, not legal advice. Every assessment is produced by versioned, sourced rules and returns reasons with rule ids, versions, sources and effective dates. AI is optional, labelled, and never makes a regulatory decision. Check each response's `pack.status`: only `verified` packs are production-ready. See the versioning and deprecation policy in the docs.

post.description: Validates `inputs` against the pack's schema for `scenario_type`, runs the pack's versioned rules, and returns an explainable result. Decision support only: every response carries a disclaimer and a `human_review_recommended` flag, and the result always includes the pack's maturity status. Billable on live keys.

post.description: A secret key (the default) is returned once and cannot be retrieved again. Set `kind` to `publishable` for a key that is safe to put in a browser widget: it needs `allowed_origins`, can only hold `assess`, `read` and named `pack:<id>` scopes, can only run assessments and read pack details, and has a rate limit and a monthly cap (defaults 30 per minute; 500 test or 5,000 live calls a month). A key can only grant scopes it holds itself.

post.description: Sent to your endpoint. Verify the `Briesa-Signature` header (`t=<unix>,v1=<hex>`, HMAC-SHA256 of `<t>.<raw body>` with your endpoint secret) and reject timestamps older than 5 minutes. Respond 2xx within 10 seconds; anything else is retried after 1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h and 12 h (6 attempts in total). Redirects are not followed. Events never contain raw assessment inputs.

bearerAuth.description: API key: `bk_live_…` or `bk_test_…` (secret, server-side only) or `pk_live_…` / `pk_test_…` (publishable, for browser widgets on the key's allowed origins). Test keys run the same logic, are not billed, and responses carry `test_mode: true`.

outcome.description: One of the pack's outcomes for this scenario type

rules_pending_review.description: Rules marked needs_review that matched. They are NOT applied to the outcome.

oneOf.description: Optional, opt-in, labelled. Never changes the outcome and never decides anything.

as_of.description: The date (YYYY-MM-DD) the rules were evaluated for

reference.description: Echo of the reference you sent

inputs_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON inputs. Raw inputs are never stored.

monthly_cap.description: Most billable calls per calendar month, or null

public_key.description: The full key, for publishable keys only (they are public by design)
